name: vivi-figma-mcp

tools.name: figma_status
tools.description: Which Figma file/page is open in the Vivi plugin and how many nodes are selected. Call it first to check the plugin is connected.

tools.name: figma_selection
tools.description: The nodes currently selected in Figma: their full structure (layout, sizes, colors, text, fonts) as a JSON tree with node ids.

tools.name: figma_outline
tools.description: Top-level frames of the current page (id, name, size, position, child count) — use it to pick what to open with node/screenshot.

tools.name: figma_node
tools.description: Structure of one node and its children as a JSON tree (type, name, sizes, auto-layout, padding, gap, fills, strokes, radius, shadows, text with fonts, component links; vectors/lines carry fill, stroke, strokeWidth, rotation). Every node has box:[x,y,w,h] relative to the requested node. Nodes carry vars (names of bound Figma variables/styles) and asset (photo/icon + export format) where present. Text wrapped only by block width comes as one line with lines:N. Deeper trees are cut by maxNodes/depth.

ids.description: Several nodes in ONE call (up to 10) instead of id: the result is a list, one entry per node, in the same order

compact.description: Drop default values (zero padding/gap, align start/left, name = text). Default true

boxes.description: Add "box":[x,y,w,h] to every node, relative to the requested node (absolute placement). Default true

format.description: json (default): node tree. css: ready HTML with inline flex styles, var(--name, #hex) for variables bound in Figma, :root list, asset placeholders

tools.name: figma_screenshot
tools.description: PNG picture of a node exactly as it looks in Figma (use it to judge visual design: spacing, colors, hierarchy).

ids.description: Several nodes in ONE call (up to 8) instead of id: the result is a list, one entry per node, in the same order

scale.description: Explicit scale (overrides maxSize). Use 1–2 for small text; for long pages screenshot child blocks one by one

tools.name: figma_search
tools.description: Find nodes by name (or by text content) on the page or inside one frame; filter by type (TEXT, FRAME, COMPONENT, INSTANCE…).

query.description: Substring of the layer name; "*" matches any node (with type)

type.description: Only this node type, e.g. TEXT or FRAME

in.description: Search inside this node id only (default: the whole page)

tools.name: figma_assets
tools.description: List the assets inside a node: photos (image fills) and icons (vectors) with id, name, size and the best export format. Use it before export to get the exact ids. Accepts a node id or a figma.com link with node-id.

id.description: Node id ("12:345", "12-345") or a Figma link with ?node-id=…

ids.description: Several nodes in ONE call (up to 10) instead of id: the result is a list, one entry per node, in the same order

tools.name: figma_export
tools.description: Save nodes as image files (PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF) on disk and return their paths — to use photos and icons from the design in code. Default format: svg for vector icons, png for the rest; raster scale 0.5–4 (default 2). Files are written only inside the current project: <project>/figma-exports by default, or the absolute folder passed as dir (must be inside the project).

ids.description: Node ids (or links with node-id) to export

folder.description: Subfolder name inside the target folder, letters (any language), digits, space, - _ .

dir.description: Absolute target folder INSIDE the current project (e.g. <project>/public/img); anything outside the project is refused. Default: <project>/figma-exports

tools.name: figma_export_assets
tools.description: One call: find every photo and icon inside a node and save them as files (icons as svg, photos as png@2x). Identical images are saved once. Returns the list of assets with paths.

id.description: Node id or Figma link with node-id

kinds.description: Which assets to export, default all

folder.description: Subfolder inside the target folder (letters (any language), digits, space, - _ .)

dir.description: Absolute target folder INSIDE the current project (e.g. <project>/public/img); anything outside the project is refused. Default: <project>/figma-exports

tools.name: figma_tokens
tools.description: Design tokens used inside a node: colors (with usage fill/text/stroke), fonts (family, weight, size, line height), radii, gaps, paddings, shadows — most used first. Use it to write CSS variables.

id.description: Node id or Figma link with node-id

ids.description: Several nodes in ONE call (up to 10) instead of id: the result is a list, one entry per node, in the same order

tools.name: figma_design_system
tools.description: Local styles and variables of the file: color styles, text styles, variables with values, plus the list of components.

tools.name: figma_create
tools.description: Build a design in the open Figma file as REAL nodes (frames, auto-layout, text, shapes, photos, icons) from a JSON spec. One section per call (up to ~80 nodes); returns rootId, node tree with ids, lint issues, warnings and a screenshot. New top-level frames are placed in free space (right of what is already on the page, top-aligned; direction:'below' puts them under it, after:<id> next to a given node, x/y exact) so they never overlap. Use parent to put it inside a container, replace to rebuild an existing node in place. Undo with figma_undo. Stock photos (image.query) are searched on the internet by the keywords. Spec = a tree of nodes, each {"type":...}: frame (layout none|vertical|horizontal, gap, padding [v,h]|[t,r,b,l], align, cross, w/h number|"hug"|"fill", fill "#RRGGBB"|gradient, radius, stroke, strokeWidth, shadow, clip, children), text (text, fontSize, fontWeight regular|medium|semibold|bold, fontFamily, color, align, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textCase, w), rect, ellipse, line, image ({"query":"keywords"} downloads a stock photo; or "data" base64 + "mime"), icon ({"icon":"arrow-right"} Lucide name; "ph:heart" Phosphor if installed), instance ({"component":"<id|name>","overrides":{...}}), shape/bool (vector shapes). Root must be a frame with a numeric w. Auto-layout by default ("hug" + padding), no emoji, real copy. Call figma_guide before the first design — it has the full schema and the design rules.

parent.description: Container node id to insert into (default: the current page)

replace.description: Node id to delete and rebuild from this spec (only for an explicit redesign)

after.description: Place the new frame next to this node (right of it, or below with direction:'below') instead of the default

direction.description: Where free space is taken: right of everything on the page (default) or below it / below 'after'

x.description: Explicit position on the page (needs y too)

tools.name: figma_edit
tools.description: Change existing nodes with a list of operations run in order: update (fields: name, fill, stroke, radius, shadow, text, fontSize, color, w, h, layout, gap, padding, align…; bulk via "ids":[..] or "match":{in,name,text,type}), move, delete, insert (a full node spec into a parent), duplicate, rename, reorder, restructure (regroup nodes by a target tree), group/ungroup, make_component, combine_variants, rebuild. Ids come from figma_node/figma_outline. An op that creates a node may carry "as":"name" — later ops refer to it as "$name" ("$page" = current page). Returns warnings (failed ops), lint issues, changed trees and a screenshot. See figma_guide for the full op list.

tools.name: figma_undo
tools.description: Revert the last N write runs (figma_create / figma_edit calls) made through this plugin: restores changed nodes and removes created ones. Default 1; the last 8 runs are kept.

runs.description: How many recent runs to revert, default 1

tools.name: figma_schema
tools.description: Full schema text of rarely used spec parts: "shapes" (blob/wave/star/polygon/ring/path + boolean ops + masks), "grouping" (group/ungroup). Without name lists the names.

tools.name: figma_guide
tools.description: Design guide for creating designs: spec = node schema (all fields), craft = sizing + design rules, components = reusing components, edits = workflow and the list of edit operations. Read spec and edits (and craft for pages) BEFORE the first figma_create. Without topic returns spec + edits.

tools.name: figma_icons
tools.description: Find icon names for {"type":"icon","icon":"<name>"}: Lucide (always) plus Phosphor "ph:", Tabler "tabler:", Material "ms:" when installed. Returns up to 20 matches for a keyword.
